entity_name: Ministry of Energy and Water (وزارة الطاقة والمياه)

facts.value: Ministry of Energy and Water. Policy and regulatory authority over electricity sector (supervises EDL, EDZ, generators), water sector (supervises 4 water establishments), and oil infrastructure. Handles ministerial-level escalations when EDL/water authority fails to respond. NOT an operational complaint body — routes field complaints to relevant entity. Complaint domains encoded for routing: energy_policy_escalation, water_policy_escalation, electricity_regulatory_complaint, generator_licensing, oil_infrastructure.

Not responsible for / boundary conditions: operational_electricity_faults(EDL_EDZ); water_supply_issues(water_establishments); direct_customer_service; private_well_license_or_groundwater_permit; Route instead to MEW when Complaint asks about well license tracking or regulatory permit status.; first_line_field_repair_or_outage_dispatch; Route instead to WATER_ESTABLISHMENT_BY_LOCATION when Ordinary outage leak dirty water billing or service request has a regional WE owner.; first_line_outage_or_fault_dispatch; Route instead to EDL_OR_EDZ_BY_LOCATION when MEW is policy and escalation not ordinary field repair.
facts.notes: Runtime cases may still require HITL when asset ownership, location, or public/private responsibility is ambiguous.

facts.value: Geographic scope: national. national water policy or ministry-level escalation Use MEW only for policy oversight or escalation after the regional WE is identified. Route public network water complaints to WE but regulatory well-license tracking to MEW workflow. Use MEW only after operational entity is identified and ordinary field route is not enough.
